newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W.Australia to call for petrochem interest.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W.Australia to call for petrochem interest.

text.p: The Western Australia state government will soon call for expressions of interest in the development of a world-scale petrochemical project, state Resources Development Minister Colin Barnett said on Thursday.
Barnett told a Perth business luncheon there was no doubt about available markets, both international and local, or the availability of gas for such a project.
There was only room for one project, however, and the government had a role to play in encouraging the necessary investment interest, Barnett said.
"(Petrochemicals) has been a fairly controversial topic in this state," Barnett said.

"But there is no doubt that, in the Pilbara, following de-regulation (of gas) and the great demand for (petrochemicals) in Asia that one world-scale petrochemical project will be viable," Barnett said.

"There is still some testing to do to be confident of that but the government will, in the next couple of months, be seeking expressions of interest in developing a petrochemical plant," Barnett said.
